title: Sunday Sandwiches
setting: A bright family kitchen on a cold winter day.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Lily
characters.look: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots)

characters.name: Max
characters.look: Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar)

sentences.en: It is a slow Sunday in January.
sentences.zh: 这是一月里一个悠闲的星期天。
sentences.scene_prompt: A quiet kitchen in winter, snow outside the window; Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) sit relaxed in pyjamas, Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) asleep on the floor.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a lazy winter morning at home; 'Sunday' and 'January' can't be shown.

sentences.en: Making sandwiches is Lily's favourite hobby.
sentences.zh: 做三明治是莉莉最喜欢的爱好。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) happily spreads butter on bread at the kitchen counter.

sentences.en: Today she makes a large number of them.
sentences.zh: 今天她做了一大堆三明治。
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) stands proudly beside a tall pile of sandwiches.

sentences.en: Ben puts chips in his and enjoys it.
sentences.zh: 本往自己的三明治里放了薯片，吃得很开心。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) pushes crisps into his sandwich and takes a happy bite.

sentences.en: They stand by the window and talk about school.
sentences.zh: 他们站在窗边，聊着学校的事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) stand by the window eating sandwiches and chatting, a school bag on a chair behind them.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them chatting by the window; what they talk about can only be guessed.

sentences.en: They are full, so eating more is not possible.
sentences.zh: 他们吃饱了，再也吃不下了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) hold their full bellies and shake their heads at a few sandwiches still on the plate.
sentences.draw_note: Shows them too full to eat; 'not possible' is only implied.

sentences.en: Then something funny happens: Max takes one!
sentences.zh: 接着发生了一件好笑的事：麦克斯叼走了一个！
sentences.scene_prompt: Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) jumps up at the table and runs off with a sandwich in his mouth.

sentences.en: Lily laughs, "Max must love sandwiches too!"
sentences.zh: 莉莉笑着说：“麦克斯一定也爱吃三明治！”
sentences.scene_prompt: Lily (a seven-year-old girl with red hair in two pigtails and a yellow dress with white dots) laughs and points at Max (a small brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar) eating the sandwich on the floor while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) grins.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Lily laughing at Max eating a sandwich; the spoken words can only be guessed.
